vendor: SC SocialBee Labs SRL (part of WebPros International GmbH)
product_family: SocialBee is an AI-assisted social media management SaaS (content creation, scheduling/publishing, analytics, engagement, team collaboration) sold in three tiers (Bootstrap, Accelerate, Pro) with a single shared data-handling model; no separate consumer/enterprise product line was found.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. No trust center, security page, privacy policy, or terms of service on socialbee.com mentions SOC 2, and no independent source confirms a SOC 2 report.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not referenced on socialbee.com privacy policy, terms of service, or deletion policy, and no independent source confirms certification.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: WebPros has decided to make the principles of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applicable to all its global entities as a common standard.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. No mention of HIPAA, PHI, or a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) anywhere on socialbee.com; social media scheduling tools of this kind are not typically positioned for protected health information.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. No PCI DSS statement on vendor pages; card payment handling, if any, is not described in detail on the reviewed pages (likely delegated to a third-party payment processor, which would be out of SocialBee's direct scope).

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on socialbee.com.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. SocialBee publishes an AI-training opt-out commitment for its 'AI Features' but does not claim ISO/IEC 42001 or any formal AI-governance certification.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on socialbee.com.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found; SocialBee does not market to U.S. federal government customers.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states: 'We do not use any data submitted through AI Features — including inputs, prompts, conversation content, or outputs — to train, fine-tune, retrain, or otherwise improve any large language model.' This commitment is scoped to the AI Features specifically; no separate statement was found about training on general account/content data outside AI Features.
privacy.data_region: Primary hosting/processing not explicitly pinned to one region in the reviewed pages; privacy policy describes transfers to the USA, Switzerland, Japan, and Canada, and use of Google Ireland Limited / Google LLC (USA) under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for EU data subjects.

security.name: Two-factor authentication
security.value: Available for user accounts via authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Duo, Authy) or email code

security.name: Encryption in transit / at rest
security.value: Not explicitly published: no dedicated security page or trust center on socialbee.com states specific encryption protocols (e.g. TLS, AES); the marketing site itself is served over HTTPS but no formal vendor statement was located to confirm application-level encryption practices.

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Users may request permanent deletion of account data (username, email, contact info, other identifiers) by emailing success@socialbee.com

security.name: Subprocessor agreements
security.value: Privacy policy states each third party entrusted with personal data is bound by a Data Processing Agreement in line with applicable data protection laws; this describes SocialBee's own vendor/subprocessor contracts, not a confirmed self-serve customer-facing DPA.

products.name: SocialBee (Bootstrap / Accelerate / Pro plans)
products.category: Social media management SaaS (scheduling, AI content generation, analytics, engagement, collaboration)
products.data_scope: Connected social media account credentials/tokens, uploaded media and captions, brand/content data, team member accounts, analytics data pulled from connected platforms
products.notes: Single product tiered by number of connected channels, users, workspaces, and analytics history; no evidence of a separate enterprise-only security tier or self-hosted option.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS subscription (Bootstrap $29/mo, Accelerate $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, annual discount available); 14-day free trial
compare.data_residency: Not pinned to a single region; transfers described to USA, Switzerland, Japan, Canada per privacy policy

flags: No trust center or dedicated security page is published. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 status could not be confirmed from the privacy policy, terms of service, deletion policy, or public search, which is typical for a growth-stage social media tool; this is not the same as an explicit vendor denial of these certifications.
Not to be confused with WPP, an unrelated global advertising holding company with its own SOC 2/ISO 27001 trust center; SocialBee's parent/contact entity is WebPros International GmbH (Switzerland).

The privacy policy's DPA language describes SocialBee's agreements with its own subprocessors, not a confirmed self-serve or signable customer-facing DPA. Enterprise buyers who need a DPA should confirm directly with SocialBee sales or support.

AI-training opt-out commitment is scoped explicitly to 'AI Features' (inputs/prompts/outputs); no separate statement covers training on general connected-account or content data outside that feature set.
No HIPAA/BAA offering found; not suitable for protected health information use cases.
